import requests, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import Counter
name='(E)-1-ethoxycarbonyloxyethoxyimino-[(2S)-2-[[4-[5-(4-methylphenyl)-3-(trifluoromethyl)pyrazol-1-yl]phenyl]sulfonylcarbamoyl]pyrrolidin-1-yl]-oxidoazanium'
r=requests.get('https://opsin.ch.cam.ac.uk/opsin/'+requests.utils.quote(name,safe=''),timeout=20).json()
root=ET.fromstring(r['cml'])
ns={'c':'http://www.xml-cml.org/schema'}
counts=Counter()
for atom in root.findall('.//c:atom',ns):
    el=atom.attrib.get('elementType')
    if el: counts[el]+=1
print(counts)
print('formula',''.join(k+(str(v) if v>1 else '') for k,v in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: (x[0]!='C', x[0]!='H', x[0]))) )
